download_dreambooth_dataset: download the DreamBooth dataset from GitHub using sparse checkout into a specified data directory
load_dreambooth_prompts: load and generate prompts for each DreamBooth subject image using predefined prompt templates
create_lookup_key: create a lookup key string from a subject name, image name, and prompt index
review_dreambooth_subjects: review the DreamBooth live subject and object mappings and their associated prompt templates
summarize_dreambooth_module: summarize the DreamBooth source module functions for downloading data and generating subject-driven prompts
